rationale.text: The html element carries lang="fr_FR", a locale name with an underscore, as some content systems write it. The glossary describes the indication as two parts separated by a hyphen and validity as concerning the code before the hyphen, which must be a code of 2 or 3 characters from ISO 639. With no hyphen, the code part is the whole value fr_FR, which is no ISO 639 code, so the code is not valid. The custom check faults it, through a link whose fault means failure, so the finding is failed at both levels.

citations.quote: Le code de langue est valide ;
Code de 2 caractères (ISO 639-1) ou 3 caractères (ISO 639-2 et suivants) permettant d’indiquer la langue d’un document ou d’un passage de texte.
L’indication du code de langue est constituée de deux parties séparées par un tiret
L’indication du code de langue ne concerne que la partie [code] avant le tiret.
